protocol.metric: Mean of per-query mean absolute gold-token logprob differences against BF16
protocol.repeat: First cohort repeated once in the same engine
protocol.head: Logprob requests use the complete head: BF16 on 2B, the existing NVFP4 head with K2048 BF16 score refinement on 4B. Hybrid candidate selection is evaluated separately.
protocol.scope: Current packaged quality mode, fixed whole-cohort teacher forcing. These runs measure numerical fidelity, not task accuracy.

2b.anchor: Frozen BF16 M32 anchor at both shapes

4b.anchor: Frozen BF16 anchor at each matching physical shape
